notes: PROPOSED v1 — District 2 first slice ONLY (the 400 m x 400 m around Northgate, 11 plots). The other 29 District 2 plots keep building_id null in data/district2-blockout.json — no second-slice buildings are invented. Residential rent/buy per unit come from data/prices.json rent_monthly_by_tier (tier 1: 2500/null, tier 2: 4000/350000, tier 3: 6000/750000) — the validator checks every residential entry against that table. Commercial rent/buy mirror the closest District 1 analogue of the same type + tier (cited per building; D1's own note calls these v1 seed extrapolations of the same tier model, ≈0.8-1% of value per month, pending Phase 6 tuning). Unit counts are PROPOSED estimates from the D1 analogue (cited per building). All 11 buildings are for rent at opening (for_rent_units = units) and none is listed for sale (for_sale_units = 0) — sales open only after the owner confirms the PROPOSED layout. The blockout file's plot-level building_id fields stay null by design until that confirmation (a one-line data edit per plot then); the link plot -> building lives here, as each building's plot_id, and the validator checks the 1:1 coverage of the first slice.
